commands: PLUGINS='workflow-aggregator credentials credentials-binding git git-client docker-workflow docker-plugin kubernetes aws-credentials amazon-ecr ssh-agent job-dsl'

if command -v jenkins-plugin-cli >/dev/null 2>&1; then jenkins-plugin-cli --plugins $PLUGINS; else if [ -x /usr/local/bin/jenkins-plugin-cli ]; then /usr/local/bin/jenkins-plugin-cli --plugins $PLUGINS; else echo 'jenkins-plugin-cli not found, attempting to install via dnf'; sudo dnf install -y jenkins-plugin-cli || true; fi; fi
